Protein Food

Cod Fillet

About This Entry

Cod fillet is lean, flaky, and mild — fish and chips, baking, and poaching. Crisp whites (Sancerre, Albariño) and dry sparkling are natural matches.

Beginner Guide

Atlantic cod is classic; Pacific cod is a related species often substituted.

Common Culinary Uses

  • bake

FAQ

What is Cod Fillet?
Atlantic cod is classic; Pacific cod is a related species often substituted.
How should Cod Fillet be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
